name: Tangle Cloud
description: Tangle Cloud is the control plane for the Tangle operator layer: discover blueprints and embedded apps, deploy service instances with chosen operators and payment/security settings, register and manage operator capacity, and track requests, jobs, payments, rewards, and earnings. It is a client-side single-page app; every write (deploy a service, register as an operator, approve a request, publish a blueprint, claim rewards) is an EVM transaction signed by the user's own wallet, so an agent cannot transact on a user's behalf here. An agent's job on this property is to read public on-chain state and route its user to the right console page with context.
agent_setup_note: This product has no setup skill of its own: there is nothing to install and no API key. agent_setup points at the Tangle ecosystem hub skill, which covers the agent-ready products that do have a self-serve flow.
custody: All state-changing actions are EVM transactions signed by the user's own wallet in the browser. An agent must never ask for or handle a user's keys; direct the user to the relevant console page instead.

network_data.note: Public chain endpoints the console itself is configured to read. No key is required. They belong to the networks, not to this site; their availability tracks each network's own status.

tempo_moderato.detail: Hosts the live tnt-core deployment. Native gas is a USD stablecoin.

embedded_apps: Blueprint apps run as sandboxed iframes under *.blueprint.tangle.tools behind publisher, host, and metadata trust gates. Prefer the agent-facing product behind an app: e.g. the Tangle Sandbox app (https://agent-sandbox.blueprint.tangle.tools) is served by https://sandbox.tangle.tools, which has its own manifest and setup skill.
